items.name: LogPath
items.summary: A path to a valid delta log file. You can parse a given `FileMeta` into a `LogPath` using [`LogPath::try_new`].

methods.name: staged_commit
methods.signature: fn staged_commit(table_root: Url, filename: &str, last_modified: i64, size: FileSize) -> DeltaResult<LogPath>
methods.summary: Create a new staged commit log path given the table root and filename and metadata. The table_root must point to the root of the table and end with a '/'.

methods.name: staged_commit_url
methods.summary: Create the URL for a staged commit file given the table root and filename. The table_root must point to the root of the table and end with a '/'.

methods.name: try_new
methods.summary: Attempt to create a `LogPath` from `FileMeta`. This returns an error if the path isn't a valid log path.
